commit.message:
Include fixed per-concat overhead in node estimate

A StringConcat with zero append arguments (e.g. new StringBuilder().toString())
was given a node budget of num_arguments * estimated_nodes_per_concat_arg == 0,
so the debug assert fired even though replace_string_concat legitimately creates
a small, fixed number of nodes for the allocation elision, array setup and
toString replacement. Budget one extra argument's worth of nodes to cover this
fixed overhead that is not attributable to any single argument. Fixes crashes in
compiler/c2/irTests/stringopts/TestNegativeArraySize and
compiler/intrinsics/string/TestStringIntrinsics.
